subject: FluxData MSA + Order Form — party roster, template preference, and timeline
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@fluxdata.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <pshah@fluxdata.com>
Date: 2026-07-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood MSA / Order Form — next steps

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the demo last week — excited to move forward. Attaching our standard MSA and a draft order form so legal on both sides can take a first pass. Our commercial team would like to close contract and get a sandbox environment staged by the end of July.

Quick context: FluxData is evaluating Redwood for inference serving on GPU-backed private clusters; expected seat count will be ~40 seats for Q4 pilot and scaling thereafter. We have a standard set of redlines in our MSA but are open to using Redwood's template if it shortens review time.

Attachments (sent): FluxData_MSA_v1.docx, FluxData_OrderForm_v1.xlsx

Primary asks:
- Can you confirm which template your team prefers (Redwood standard or our MSA)?
- Who should be on the signature path for billing and legal?
- Any immediate non-starters (data residency, SOC2, export controls)?

If it helps, Priya (cc'd) will coordinate procurement and can provide the PO once we have an approved order form.

Appreciate a quick read — can you confirm estimated turnaround for first-pass redlines?

Best,
Alex Chen
Head of IT Procurement
FluxData
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@fluxdata.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <pshah@fluxdata.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-05T10:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood MSA / Order Form — next steps

Alex — thanks and great to hear. I got the attachments and shared them with Legal and Contracts (cc). A few items from our side to speed things up:

1) Template preference: If your team can accept Redwood's MSA (we'll attach a clean copy), we can usually turn first-pass redlines in 48 business hours. If you prefer to keep FluxData_MSA_v1 as the baseline, we will still review but it typically adds a day to the cycle. Please confirm.

2) Required party/contacts we need to capture now:
- Commercial lead for PO/billing (name, email, billing address)
- Technical owner for SOW/scope (who will sign Exhibit A)
- Security contact for evidence exchange (SOC2, pen test)
- Signing authority name and title for legal sign-off

3) Data residency & compliance: please flag if EU/APAC residency is required — we note this upfront since it affects hosting exhibits.

4) Timeline ask: To meet your end-of-July sandbox target, we suggest: first-pass redlines by 2026-07-07, finalize order form by 2026-07-12, and signature/PO by 2026-07-16. Does that work on your side?

I attached a one-page party roster template and Redwood clean MSA link for quick comparison.

Attachments referenced: Redwood_Clean_MSA_v1.docx (link sent separately), Party_Roster_Template.xlsx

Mina Haddad
Senior Contracts Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex.chen@fluxdata.com>, Priya Shah <pshah@fluxdata.com>
Date: 2026-07-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Redwood MSA / Order Form — priority for redline pass (FluxData)

Kimberly / David — forwarding FluxData MSA + Order Form. They indicated SOC2 evidence is required and residency is US-only for now.

Key negotiation points I expect:
- Data residency exhibit: likely straightforward (US-only) but will need Exhibit B mapping.
- Indemnity / liability caps: expect counters from FluxData — please flag any strict non-starters.
- IP / model output: FluxData uses private model hosting; we should confirm standard Redwood wording on customer models / inference outputs.
- Order form: confirm billing cadence (FluxData indicated PO + Net30) and seat count.

Proposed internal timeline:
- Please provide redlines and comments on the FluxData_MSA_v1 doc by EOD 2026-07-07 (48 business hours).
- Contracts to prepare a redline using Track Changes and a short comment deck summarizing material concessions.

Attachments attached by Alex are listed above; I'm attaching the Party_Roster_Template.xlsx I asked them to fill.

On internal priority: this is a medium-high deal (expected pilot ARR). If Legal/Contracts can hit the 7/7 window we can keep the pipeline target.

— Mina
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@fluxdata.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <pshah@fluxdata.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-07T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood MSA / Order Form — priority for redline pass (FluxData)

Thanks Mina — timeline works for us. Per your checklist, Priya is attaching the completed Party_Roster_Template and our SOC2 report (June 2026). We are happy to start from Redwood's clean MSA if that speeds things up — please send your template and we'll confirm any material deviations.

Attachments added: FluxData_Party_Roster_filled.xlsx, FluxData_SOC2_Report_June2026.pdf

Also: we'll route signature via DocuSign once an executed order form is agreed. If Redwood prefers to send the first redline on your MSA, please go ahead and we will review.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Alex
